topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate recognition principles: PAMPs, DAMPs, and PRRs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses infection and tissue damage using molecular patterns and germline-encoded pattern recognition receptors.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptor families, signaling, and the inflammasome
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the major classes of pattern recognition receptors, including Toll-like receptors, alternative cytoplasmic sensors, and the assembly and regulation of the inflammasome.

topics.label: Inflammatory mediator release, leukocyte trafficking, and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover how sentinel cells trigger inflammatory cascades, orchestrate leukocyte extravasation into tissues, drain antigens to lymph nodes, and risk causing septic shock when overactivated.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the passive and active mechanisms that terminate inflammation, drive wound healing, and manage persistent challenges through chronic inflammation and granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on complement.
